mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, actor_type, actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, ip, user_agent, details, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, CAST(#{ip} AS inet), #{userAgent}, CAST(#{details} AS jsonb), #{createdAt})
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.actor_type, a.actor_id, coalesce(u.display_name, u.email) AS actor_name, a.action, a.target_type, a.target_id, a.details::text AS details, host(a.ip) AS ip, a.created_at FROM audit_logs a LEFT JOIN staff_users u ON a.actor_type = 'STAFF' AND u.id = a.actor_id
ORDER BY a.created_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT DISTINCT action FROM audit_logs ORDER BY action
